title: 434. "I lost my brother at 16 to suicide, it shouldn't have happened" ft. Ben West

sentences.en: This is an iHeart PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 这是iHeart播客。

sentences.en: Guaranteed human.
sentences.zh: 纯人工制作。

sentences.en: I've been approaching my health really differently this year.
sentences.zh: 今年我对待健康的方式有了很大的改变。

sentences.en: I used to be really focused on maximizing and doing more.
sentences.zh: 过去我总是专注于追求极致，想要做得更多。

sentences.en: And now I'm just realizing that if I listen to what my body needs, I perform way better.
sentences.zh: 但现在我意识到，如果我倾听身体的需求，我的表现反而会好得多。

sentences.en: And that's why I am obsessed with my Whoop.
sentences.zh: 这就是我为什么对Whoop如此着迷的原因。

sentences.en: Truly, you guys, you know I'm such a data and information-driven person.
sentences.zh: 说真的，你们知道我是一个非常依赖数据和信息的人。

sentences.en: And I love opening my Whoop app and seeing how my sleep, my stress, my strain, is correlating with my mood, with my running performance, with how I'm just feeling day-to-day.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢打开Whoop应用程序，看看我的睡眠、压力、劳累程度如何与我的情绪、跑步表现以及我每天的感受相关联。

sentences.en: I'm not an elite athlete by any means, but I do really benefit.
sentences.zh: 我绝不是什么精英运动员，但我确实从中受益匪浅。

sentences.en: And I also just really enjoy knowing more about my body.
sentences.zh: 而且我也真的很喜欢更深入地了解自己的身体。

sentences.en: And Whoop also gives me these actionable, personalized insights that have made me more intentional and meant that I make smarter decisions day-to-day
sentences.zh: Whoop还为我提供了可操作的个性化见解，这让我变得更有意识，也意味着我每天能做出更明智的决定，

sentences.en: about what I need rather than just putting my foot on the gas and just going, going, going, going.
sentences.zh: 而不是一味地踩油门，不停地向前冲。

sentences.en: New members can try Whoop with a 30-day free trial before committing to a membership.
sentences.zh: 新用户在订阅会员之前，可以先通过Whoop的30天免费试用进行体验。

sentences.en: That's join.whoop.com slash psychology for your free month of Whoop.
sentences.zh: 访问join.whoop.com/psychology即可获得一个月的免费Whoop体验。

sentences.en: Some items we hold onto because they take us straight back to a moment.
sentences.zh: 有些物品我们一直珍藏，是因为它们能瞬间把我们带回某个时刻。

sentences.en: A photo, a piece of clothing, a tiny souvenir from somewhere unforgettable.
sentences.zh: 一张照片、一件衣服、或是来自某个难忘之地的微小纪念品。

sentences.en: In my new podcast, Charmed, with Sam Todd, we explore the memories, obsessions, and personal treasures that become part of who we are.
sentences.zh: 在我和Sam Todd合作的新播客《Charmed》中，我们探索了那些成为我们生命一部分的记忆、执念和私人珍宝。

sentences.en: From the sublime all the way to the absolutely ridiculous, it's a fascinating deep dive into the keepsakes we hold close and the memories that make them special.
sentences.zh: 从崇高到绝对荒谬，这是一次对我们珍视的纪念品以及赋予它们特殊意义的记忆的迷人深度挖掘。

sentences.en: Charmed with me, Sam Todd.
sentences.zh: 《Charmed》，我是Sam Todd。

sentences.en: Stories willing to tell with Pandora.
sentences.zh: 与Pandora共同呈现的真实故事。

sentences.en: Listen to the podcast now on iHeart.
sentences.zh: 现在就在iHeart上收听播客。

sentences.en: Before we begin today's episode, I just want to note that this conversation includes discussions around suicide, grief, and mental health.
sentences.zh: 在开始今天的节目之前，我想提醒大家，这次谈话涉及自杀、悲伤和心理健康等话题。

sentences.en: Please just take care while listening.
sentences.zh: 请在收听时照顾好自己的情绪。

sentences.en: And if anything has brought up some heavy or difficult feelings today, reach out to somebody you trust or seek support from a mental health professional
sentences.zh: 如果今天的内容勾起了你沉重或困难的感受，请联系你信任的人，或寻求心理健康专业人士

sentences.en: or crisis service in your area.
sentences.zh: 或当地危机服务机构的支持。

sentences.en: As always, we will have links and resources in the description.
sentences.zh: 一如既往，我们会在节目描述中提供相关链接和资源。

sentences.en: You do not have to go through these hard moments alone.
sentences.zh: 你不需要独自经历这些艰难时刻。

sentences.en: So please reach out to somebody that you love.
sentences.zh: 所以请务必联系你爱的人。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: I'm Gemma Spake.
sentences.zh: 我是Gemma Spake。

sentences.en: And welcome back to The Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through the biggest changes, moments, and transitions of our 20s, and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到《你二十多岁的心理学》，这是一档探讨我们二十多岁时经历的最大变化、时刻和转变，以及它们对我们心理意味着什么的播客。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到播客。

sentences.en: It is so great to have you here back for another episode.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能回来收听新的一期节目。

sentences.en: Today's episode is a really special one because we are joined by someone whose work has opened up some incredibly important conversations around mental health,
sentences.zh: 今天的节目非常特别，因为我们邀请到了一位嘉宾，他的工作围绕心理健康、

sentences.en: grief, masculinity, vulnerability for, if I'm being honest, an entire generation of young people.
sentences.zh: 悲伤、男子气概和脆弱性，开启了一些极其重要的对话，坦白说，这对整整一代年轻人来说都是如此。

sentences.en: Today, I'm joined by Ben WeSt.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的嘉宾是Ben West。

sentences.en: You may know him through his advocacy work following the loss of his younger brother.
sentences.zh: 你可能通过他在失去弟弟后所做的倡导工作而认识他。

sentences.en: Since then, he's launched his movement,
sentences.zh: 从那时起，他发起了他的运动，

sentences.en: Reasons to Stay, to help guide strangers through difficult times.
sentences.zh: “留下的理由”（Reasons to Stay），旨在帮助引导陌生人度过困难时期。

sentences.en: But beyond that, beyond the public work,
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，在公众工作之外，

sentences.en: Ben is also somebody who is deeply thoughtful.
sentences.zh: Ben也是一个非常有思想的人。

sentences.en: He has an amazing perspective on being human, on friendship, purpose, pain, and hope.
sentences.zh: 他对身为人类、友谊、目标、痛苦和希望有着令人惊叹的见解。

sentences.en: And we are so excited to have him on.
sentences.zh: 我们非常高兴能邀请他来到节目中。

sentences.en: Ben, welcome to The Psychology of Your 20s.
sentences.zh: Ben，欢迎来到《你二十多岁的心理学》。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having me here.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我来这里。

sentences.en: I'm so excited for this chat.
sentences.zh: 我非常期待这次谈话。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it took you a second to get here.
sentences.zh: 是啊，你赶到这里还花了不少时间。

sentences.en: We're recording it on a day of a crazy tutor.
sentences.zh: 我们录制节目的这一天交通简直疯了。

sentences.en: All the transport into London was just, nope, today's not my day.
sentences.zh: 所有进入伦敦的交通工具都在说，不，今天不是我的日子。

sentences.en: And you know, it's funny when you work in mental health, you're constantly talking about like coping and relieving stress.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你从事心理健康工作时，你总是谈论应对和缓解压力。

sentences.en: And then suddenly all the trains are stuck and you're having to like practice what you preach and try not to get frazzled by London transport.
sentences.zh: 然后突然间所有的火车都停运了，你不得不身体力行，努力不被伦敦的交通搞得心烦意乱。

sentences.en: But I'm here.
sentences.zh: 但我还是到了。

sentences.en: You came in cool, calm, and collected.
sentences.zh: 你进来的时候看起来冷静、沉着、镇定。

sentences.en: Inside.
sentences.zh: 内心深处。

sentences.en: I'm like a duck.
sentences.zh: 我就像一只鸭子。

sentences.en: Yeah, you're just like...
sentences.zh: 是啊，你就像……

sentences.en: Legs are going under the water.
sentences.zh: 水面下双脚在拼命划水。

sentences.en: Well, this is the thing that I've found since moving to London is I've become very angry.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是我搬到伦敦后发现的一件事，我变得非常容易生气。

sentences.en: And I have to really kind of rein it in.
sentences.zh: 我不得不努力克制一下。

sentences.en: Of the small things.
sentences.zh: 因为一些小事。

sentences.en: Yeah, just the smaller stuff.
sentences.zh: 是的，就是那些琐事。

sentences.en: I'm like, the world is a terrible, awful place.
sentences.zh: 我会觉得，这个世界真是个糟糕透顶的地方。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我懂。

sentences.en: And then the weather as well.
sentences.zh: 还有天气也是。

sentences.en: Like it's always...
sentences.zh: 总是……

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，没错。

sentences.en: It always all comes together.
sentences.zh: 所有事情都凑到了一起。

sentences.en: You've got wind, rain, trains are late.
sentences.zh: 有风、有雨、火车晚点。

sentences.en: Someone's...
sentences.zh: 有人……

sentences.en: Someone spills coffee on you.
sentences.zh: 有人把咖啡洒在你身上。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Or worse.
sentences.zh: 或者更糟。

sentences.en: Or it's really difficult to try and get out of that funk.
sentences.zh: 想要摆脱那种沮丧情绪真的很难。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: And then like a light is flickering and you're like, I just want to lay down.
sentences.zh: 然后灯光还在闪烁，你会觉得，我只想躺下。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: I used to be...
sentences.zh: 我过去常常……

sentences.en: Not to go straight in with the psychology, but I used to be really bad at having that happen and then immediately writing off the day and getting into a bad mood.
sentences.zh: 不是要直接进入心理学话题，但我过去很不擅长处理这种情况，一旦发生，我就会立刻否定这一天，陷入坏情绪中。

sentences.en: And it actually came up when I was going through therapy like that bad days would just take over and become bad days.
sentences.zh: 这其实是在我做心理咨询时提到的，那些糟糕的日子会接管一切，变成彻底的坏日子。

sentences.en: And it was that.
sentences.zh: 就是那样。

sentences.en: It was that experience that actually I started my first rule I have with myself, which is that if it's a bad day, you have to do something good.
sentences.zh: 正是那种经历让我开始了我对自己制定的第一条规则，那就是如果这一天很糟糕，你必须做一件好事。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: And so it was something we came up with in therapy, which was like I always just had...
sentences.zh: 这是我们在咨询中想出来的，因为我总是……

sentences.en: As soon as bad things happen, I just formed the mindset that it was a bad day.
sentences.zh: 一旦坏事发生，我就形成了“今天很糟糕”的心态。

sentences.en: And so I have this rule where you have to do something good.
sentences.zh: 所以我有一条规则，你必须做一件好事。

sentences.en: So that's something simple like talking to a shopkeeper in the shops or texting a friend you haven't spoken to in a while
sentences.zh: 这可以是简单的事情，比如和店主聊聊天，或者给很久没联系的朋友发条短信，

sentences.en: or just doing something good or being happy to see someone.
sentences.zh: 或者只是做点好事，或者因为见到某人而感到高兴。

sentences.en: And then as soon as you've done that, you've taken the power away from the bad day.
sentences.zh: 一旦你做了这些，你就从坏日子手中夺回了控制权。

sentences.en: So not to go straight in with the psychology, but this is actually very relevant to something that I...
sentences.zh: 所以，不是要直接进入心理学话题，但这实际上与我……

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个。

sentences.en: It's one of my two important rules that I live by.
sentences.zh: 这是我赖以生存的两条重要规则之一。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, I have two follow-up questions.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我有两个后续问题。

sentences.en: Let's go.
sentences.zh: 来吧。

sentences.en: Number one is what are you going to do today?
sentences.zh: 第一个是，你今天打算做什么？

sentences.en: I haven't decided yet.
sentences.zh: 我还没决定。

sentences.en: I feel like this is quite a good thing to do.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这其实是一件挺好的事。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的。

sentences.en: Well, this is work.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是工作。

sentences.en: This is going to be my...
sentences.zh: 这将是我的……

sentences.en: Yeah, no, I think I'm going to an event later, which will be really good.
sentences.zh: 是的，不，我想我待会儿要去参加一个活动，那会很棒。

sentences.en: So I think that will be my good thing for today.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为那将是我今天的好事。

sentences.en: And that's supporting an amazing charity.
sentences.zh: 那是为了支持一个很棒的慈善机构。

sentences.en: And it's going to be such a lovely evening.
sentences.zh: 那会是一个非常美好的夜晚。

sentences.en: So I feel like that will be my good thing today.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉那会是我今天的好事。

sentences.en: But even if it's just literally going into the shops and forcing yourself to get into shops and then talk, actually talk to the person at checkout, it always makes the day better.
sentences.zh: 但即使只是去商店，强迫自己进去，然后和收银员聊聊天，哪怕只是简单交流，也总能让这一天变得更好。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And what's your second rule?
sentences.zh: 那你的第二条规则是什么？

sentences.en: My second rule is because of the nature of my job, and we'll get into this, I talk to a lot of people about some really awful stuff.
sentences.zh: 我的第二条规则是因为我工作的性质，我们稍后会深入讨论，我经常和人们谈论一些非常糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: And so my other rule is that
sentences.zh: 所以我的另一条规则是，

sentences.en: I'm still thinking about a conversation.
sentences.zh: 如果我还在想某次谈话，

sentences.en: Two weeks later, I have to talk to someone about it.
sentences.zh: 两周后，我必须找人谈谈这件事。

sentences.en: And I don't give myself the choice.
sentences.zh: 我不给自己选择的余地。

sentences.en: Because, you know, some of the conversations I have with people are fairly harrowing.
sentences.zh: 因为你知道，我和人们进行的一些谈话相当令人痛苦。

sentences.en: And usually I'm quite good at processing that.
sentences.zh: 通常我处理这些事情的能力还不错。

sentences.en: But yeah, if I'm still thinking about it, I was thinking about them two weeks later,
sentences.zh: 但如果两周后我还在想这件事，还在想他们，

sentences.en: I have to talk to someone about that conversation.
sentences.zh: 我就必须找人谈谈那次谈话。

sentences.en: And it just takes my choice away.
sentences.zh: 这让我没得选。

sentences.en: So I know then I'm like, oh, it's been two weeks.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道，哦，已经两周了。

sentences.en: I need to text my counsellor.
sentences.zh: 我需要给我的咨询师发短信。

sentences.en: I need to go and book some time in and talk about this.
sentences.zh: 我需要预约时间去谈谈这件事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It sort of takes that opportunity to push the can down the road away from me.
sentences.zh: 这让我无法再把问题拖延下去。

sentences.en: I used to have this one I used to do.
sentences.zh: 我以前也有过一个习惯。

sentences.en: This is, we are going in.
sentences.zh: 这是，我们要深入探讨了。

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I used to do interviews for the Australian government on child maltreatment.
sentences.zh: 我以前为澳大利亚政府做过关于虐待儿童的访谈。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And as in like calling people up and being like, you know, tell me about what you've been through.
sentences.zh: 就是那种打电话给人们，问他们“告诉我你经历了什么”。

sentences.en: And I was so young.
sentences.zh: 那时我太年轻了。

sentences.en: I wish I had that rule.
sentences.zh: 我真希望当时有那条规则。

sentences.en: Because my rule was just like, if I had a bad call,
sentences.zh: 因为我的规则只是，如果我接了一个糟糕的电话，

sentences.en: I'd go and eat a kinder bueno.
sentences.zh: 我就去吃一根健达缤纷乐（Kinder Bueno）。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think that probably made my,
sentences.zh: 我想这可能让我……

sentences.en: I got into a really bad habit.
sentences.zh: 我养成了一个非常糟糕的习惯。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's like classic conditioning.
sentences.zh: 这就是经典的条件反射。

sentences.en: You're going to stop wanting those, right?
sentences.zh: 你以后会不想再吃那些东西的，对吧？

sentences.en: I was just going to say that even now, like thinking of it yesterday, I had a bad day and I went and got a kinder bueno.
sentences.zh: 我正想说，即使是现在，比如昨天想到这件事，我度过了糟糕的一天，我就去买了一根健达缤纷乐。

sentences.en: And I was like, we cannot go back down this road again.
sentences.zh: 然后我就想，我们不能再重蹈覆辙了。

sentences.en: I just mentioned one of kinder bueno.
sentences.zh: 我刚才提到了健达缤纷乐。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Texting counselor, kinder bueno.
sentences.zh: 给咨询师发短信，健达缤纷乐。

sentences.en: Let's see.
sentences.zh: 让我们看看。

sentences.en: I love a kinder bueno though.
sentences.zh: 不过我还是很喜欢健达缤纷乐。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: It's so good.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Can you briefly, you know what?
sentences.zh: 你能简单地，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I did not even ask you to introduce yourself.
sentences.zh: 我甚至还没让你做自我介绍。

sentences.en: That's okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: We've gone straight in.
sentences.zh: 我们直接切入正题了。

sentences.en: Can you briefly introduce yourself?
sentences.zh: 你能简单介绍一下自己吗？

sentences.en: Tell us a little bit about who you are as a person, how people might know you or they don't know who you are.
sentences.zh: 跟我们聊聊你是个什么样的人，大家可能通过什么认识你，或者如果他们不认识你，你是什么样的人。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: So my name is Ben.
sentences.zh: 我叫本。

sentences.en: I am a mental health campaigner.
sentences.zh: 我是一名心理健康倡导者。

sentences.en: The fact that I'm introducing myself as a mental health campaignist is still weird because it's not something I ever thought I'd have to do.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我以心理健康倡导者的身份介绍自己，这仍然让我觉得很奇怪，因为这不是我曾经想过自己会做的事情。

sentences.en: Growing up, I didn't know anything about mental health.
sentences.zh: 在成长过程中，我对心理健康一无所知。

sentences.en: No one had ever talked to me about mental health.
sentences.zh: 从来没有人跟我谈论过心理健康。

sentences.en: And the first time it really came up in my life was when my mom told me that my little brother,
sentences.zh: 我生命中第一次真正接触到这个话题，是我妈妈告诉我，我的弟弟，

sentences.en: Sam, had been diagnosed with depression.
sentences.zh: 萨姆，被诊断出患有抑郁症。

sentences.en: And that was the first time I'd ever really heard what that was.
sentences.zh: 那是我第一次真正听说那是什么。

sentences.en: I didn't really know anything more about it.
sentences.zh: 我当时对它一无所知。

sentences.en: So I never spoke to Sam.
sentences.zh: 所以我从来没跟萨姆谈过。

sentences.en: And then very sadly, in January 2018,
sentences.zh: 然后非常令人难过的是，在2018年1月，

sentences.en: Sam took his own life and died at the age of 15 years old.
sentences.zh: 萨姆结束了自己的生命，年仅15岁。

sentences.en: And I was 17.
sentences.zh: 当时我17岁。

sentences.en: And obviously through that experience, I very quickly realized that the significance of what my mom had told me in September.
sentences.zh: 显然，通过那次经历，我很快意识到我妈妈在九月份告诉我的事情的重要性。

sentences.en: And also through speaking to my friends and people at school, realized like how many people were affected by this sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 而且通过与朋友和学校里的人交谈，我意识到有多少人受到这类事情的影响。

sentences.en: And my plan in life at that moment was to go to university, study engineering, and then go to the armed forces and fly helicopters.
sentences.zh: 当时我的人生计划是上大学，学习工程学，然后加入武装部队驾驶直升机。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So that was my plan.
sentences.zh: 所以那是我的计划。

sentences.en: Very Prince Harry coded.
sentences.zh: 很有哈里王子的风格。

sentences.en: I know, very, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我知道，确实，是的。

sentences.en: And it's not what I'm doing, as you can tell.
sentences.zh: 如你所见，我现在做的并不是这些。

sentences.en: But I realized very quickly that, you know, what happened to Sam shouldn't have happened.
sentences.zh: 但我很快意识到，你知道，萨姆身上发生的事情本不该发生。

sentences.en: And there were, there were small things that could have been different.
sentences.zh: 而且，有一些小事本可以有所不同。

sentences.en: And it felt like I had a opportunity to change those small things for other people and pick up the sort of baton that Sam left behind in terms of wanting to create change
sentences.zh: 我觉得我有一个机会为其他人改变那些小事，并接过萨姆留下的接力棒，去创造改变，

sentences.en: and do my beSt.
sentences.zh: 并尽我所能。

sentences.en: So I'm a mental health campaigner now.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在是一名心理健康倡导者。

sentences.en: I've been doing this for eight years.
sentences.zh: 我已经做了八年了。

sentences.en: People will probably, if you've heard my name, you've probably heard it in association with my project that I launched this year called Reasons to Stay,
sentences.zh: 如果你们听说过我的名字，你们可能是在我今年发起的名为“留下的理由”的项目中听到的，

sentences.en: which I'm sure we'll get into more, but essentially it's a suicide prevention project,
sentences.zh: 我相信我们稍后会深入探讨，但本质上这是一个自杀预防项目，

sentences.en: sending letters to people thinking about suicide, giving them reasons to stay.
sentences.zh: 给那些有自杀念头的人写信，给他们留下的理由。

sentences.en: But, you know, my work goes far beyond that.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我的工作远不止于此。

sentences.en: The reason I'm dressed so smartly is I've been, I work in policy.
sentences.zh: 我穿得这么正式的原因是我一直在，我在政策领域工作。

sentences.en: So I do a lot of work with the government around NHS and healthcare for people with mental health and education and mental health.
sentences.zh: 所以我做了很多与政府相关的工作，围绕英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）、心理健康患者的医疗保健，以及教育和心理健康。

sentences.en: So basically mental health is what I live and breathe.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，心理健康就是我的生活和呼吸。

sentences.en: It's not something that I ever thought I'd go into, but it's something, you know, it is everything I do.
sentences.zh: 这不是我曾经想过会从事的领域，但你知道，这就是我所做的一切。

sentences.en: And, and, you know, every day I think about Sam and what happened to him and my family.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我每天都会想到萨姆，想到发生在他和我家人身上的事。

sentences.en: And I go to work because we absolutely, I absolutely believe that we can change the system that lets so many people down.
sentences.zh: 我努力工作是因为我们绝对，我绝对相信我们可以改变那个让这么多人失望的系统。

sentences.en: And that's what I'm going to do for the rest of my life.
sentences.zh: 这就是我余生要做的事情。

sentences.en: That's what I've decided.
sentences.zh: 我已经决定了。

sentences.en: This is all I'm going to do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我唯一要做的事。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Which is a huge thing to say, but I love it.

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.zh: 比如你对他的一些记忆，以及他是个什么样的人。

sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Oh,
sentences.zh: 哦，

sentences.en: Sam was wonderful.
sentences.zh: 萨姆很棒。

sentences.en: He was very funny.
sentences.zh: 他非常幽默。

sentences.en: And in this sort of, the sort of humor he had was like, you didn't know quite whether you were allowed to laugh.
sentences.zh: 而且那种，他那种幽默感让你不知道自己是否可以笑出来。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It was always just like,
sentences.zh: 总是感觉，

sentences.en: on the edge of, of something really dark and awful.
sentences.zh: 徘徊在某种非常黑暗和可怕的边缘。

sentences.en: He had quite a dark sense of humor, but it was just so funny.
sentences.zh: 他有相当黑暗的幽默感，但真的非常有趣。

sentences.en: Even his friends, like at school, they always said he was such a like class clown.
sentences.zh: 即使是他在学校的朋友，也总是说他是那种班级里的开心果。

sentences.en: He'd try and make the whole class laugh.
sentences.zh: 他会试图逗全班同学笑。

sentences.en: He was very, very talented in art and music.
sentences.zh: 他在艺术和音乐方面非常有天赋。

sentences.en: So like he was 15 when he was, you know, basically producing whole film scores on his laptop.
sentences.zh: 所以，他15岁的时候，基本上就能在笔记本电脑上制作整部电影配乐了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Loved Hans Zimmer and film and, and film scores and music and film.
sentences.zh: 他热爱汉斯·季默，热爱电影，热爱电影配乐、音乐和电影。

sentences.en: He was also like, he, he painted a lot and just the most phenomenal painter.
sentences.zh: 他还，他画了很多画，简直是一位非凡的画家。

sentences.en: And one of my favorite, yeah.
sentences.zh: 这是我最喜欢的，是的。

sentences.en: One of my favorite memories back then of, of us as, cause it was me,
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的回忆之一，关于我们，因为当时是我，

sentences.en: Sam and another brother,
sentences.zh: 萨姆，还有另一个弟弟，

sentences.en: Tom, he's my youngest brother.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，他是我最小的弟弟。

sentences.en: And we used to just,
sentences.zh: 我们过去常常，

sentences.en: Sam would do like some art and he'd just bring us in on right at the end, just like help with something.
sentences.zh: 萨姆会做些艺术创作，然后在最后关头把我们叫进去，让我们帮点忙。

sentences.en: And we were absolutely terrible.
sentences.zh: 我们简直糟透了。

sentences.en: I'm so jealous of Sam's talent with art because I can't draw.
sentences.zh: 我非常嫉妒萨姆在艺术方面的天赋，因为我不会画画。

sentences.en: I can't paint.
sentences.zh: 我不会画画。

sentences.en: I would love to be able to paint, but I, I can't.
sentences.zh: 我真希望自己能画画，但我，我做不到。

sentences.en: Um, I struggle so much with it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我在这方面非常挣扎。

sentences.en: Um, but he was very, very talented.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但他非常有天赋。

sentences.en: Um, but I think the big thing with Sam that I like means a lot now looking back is he just had, he was like a, um,
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我认为萨姆身上最重要的一点，现在回想起来意义重大，就是他就像一个，嗯，

sentences.en: an emotional sponge.
sentences.zh: 情感海绵。

sentences.en: You just, he just absorbed all the emotion around him.
sentences.zh: 他只是，他吸收了周围所有的情绪。

sentences.en: He was such an empath and he cared so much about other people.
sentences.zh: 他非常有同理心，非常关心他人。

sentences.en: And he's this, that sense of like social, social justice of, of if someone was being picked on or bullied, he would feel he's so like powerfully that that was unjuSt.
sentences.zh: 他有一种社会正义感，如果有人被欺负或霸凌，他会强烈地感觉到那是不公正的。

sentences.en: And he'd take a lot of that emotion on, um, which obviously must've been a lot for him to take on his shoulders, but you just,
sentences.zh: 他会承担很多那种情绪，嗯，这对他来说显然肩负了太多，但你只是，

sentences.en: he just had this really strong sense of right and wrong.
sentences.zh: 他有一种非常强烈的对错观。

sentences.en: Um, and he was felt emotions and he felt other people's emotions really strongly.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他感受情绪，而且非常强烈地感受他人的情绪。

sentences.en: Um, which, you know, obviously meant that when he was struggling, he felt very passionately about other people,
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，这显然意味着当他自己挣扎时，他对他人的感受非常热切，

sentences.en: you know, feeling seen as well through their struggles.
sentences.zh: 你知道，也通过他们的挣扎感到被理解。

sentences.en: Um, and, and that's sort of why I feel like I want to do what I do now is because when he was struggling,
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是为什么我觉得我想做我现在所做的事情，因为当他挣扎时，

sentences.en: he wanted other people to feel understood and for things to be better for them.
sentences.zh: 他希望别人感到被理解，希望事情对他们来说能变得更好。

sentences.en: And he never got the chance to sort of do this.
sentences.zh: 但他从来没有机会去做这些。

sentences.en: And I know that absolutely if Sam had survived, he would have gone on to become a mental health campaigner.
sentences.zh: 我知道如果萨姆活下来，他绝对会成为一名心理健康倡导者。

sentences.en: He'd probably be sitting in this chair talking to you.
sentences.zh: 他现在可能正坐在我这个位置上跟你谈话。

sentences.en: He would have done a phenomenal job.
sentences.zh: 他会做得非常出色。

sentences.en: And I always say to people,
sentences.zh: 我总是告诉人们，

sentences.en: I'm like, unfortunately you have got the second best option, but I will, I will do my absolute best to sort of do what I think Sam would want to do.
sentences.zh: 我说，不幸的是你们得到了第二好的选择，但我会，我会尽我所能去做我认为萨姆想做的事。

sentences.en: And that is to show up, to tell our story, be vulnerable, be honest, make people feel seen, but also, you know,
sentences.zh: 那就是站出来，讲述我们的故事，展现脆弱，保持诚实，让人们感到被看见，同时也，你知道，

sentences.en: push for the change that stops people getting support and stops people getting an education.
sentences.zh: 推动变革，阻止人们无法获得支持，阻止人们无法接受教育。

sentences.en: So yeah, I, I,
sentences.zh: 所以是的，我，我，

sentences.en: I've tried to be better at art and I've tried to be better at music.
sentences.zh: 我试过在艺术上做得更好，也试过在音乐上做得更好。

sentences.en: But I know that one talent and one, one thing that me and Sam absolutely share is that absolute social justice, right and wrong empathy for,
sentences.zh: 但我知道，我和萨姆绝对共有的一个天赋，就是那种绝对的社会正义感、对错观，以及对那些不该承受这些痛苦、且在当今社会缺乏支持的人们的同理心。

sentences.en: for people that don't deserve to feel the way they do and not have the support that so many people don't have nowadays.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，你的弟弟也有这种特质吗？

sentences.en: I feel like, does your younger brother have that as well?
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 我们都有。

sentences.en: We all do.
sentences.zh: 我正想说，我觉得这可能是从你们父母那里传承下来的一条非常强烈的脉络。

sentences.en: I was going to say, I feel like that's would be a very strong through line from like your parents.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 我绝对这么认为。

sentences.en: I definitely think so.
sentences.zh: 而且他们，我的父母显然在萨姆去世后也做出了类似的反应，试图改变，改变现状并提供支持，

sentences.en: And they've, and my parents have obviously reacted in a similar way to Sam dying in terms of like trying to change, change things and provide support,
sentences.zh: 当可怕的事情发生时，很多人都会这样做。

sentences.en: which a lot of people do when, when something awful happens.
sentences.zh: 很高兴我们都在同一战线上，认为那件事太糟糕了，我们要确保它永远不会再发生。

sentences.en: And it's, it's nice that we're all sort of on the same page of, that was so bad that we're going to make sure it never happens again.
sentences.zh: 我们在这一点上非常一致。

sentences.en: We're all very aligned on that.
sentences.zh: 我看到了杰克·安东诺夫说的一件有趣的事情。

sentences.en: I saw this interesting thing from Jack Antonoff.
sentences.zh: 你知道他是谁吗？

sentences.en: Do you know who that is?
sentences.zh: 不知道。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 他是一位音乐制作人。

sentences.en: He's a music producer.
sentences.zh: 不重要。

sentences.en: Not important.
sentences.zh: 但他曾说，当你经历悲伤时，你的目标会变得最清晰，因为其他一切都不重要了。

sentences.en: But he said that when you're experiencing grief is when your purpose becomes the clearest because nothing else matters.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 这听起来就像，这就是发生在你身上的事情，你知道，通过那次经历。

sentences.en: And that kind of sounds like what, that's what's happened to you, you know, through that.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 我想我做我现在所做的事情有很多原因，但其中之一绝对是因为它太痛了，我觉得，

sentences.en: I think there's so many reasons why I do what I do now, but one of them is definitely that it's hurt so much that I think it,
sentences.zh: 没有意义的痛苦是非常难以应对的，因为它让人觉得，这一切到底是为了什么？

sentences.en: the pain without a meaning is very difficult to cope with because it feels like, what is this all for?
sentences.zh: 我是说，这太痛了。

sentences.en: I mean, and it hurts so much.
sentences.zh: 这仍然，你知道，这仍然是一件非常、非常可怕的经历。

sentences.en: It's still, you know, it's still, still a horrible, horrible thing to have gone through.
sentences.zh: 这并不会让它变得不那么痛苦，但它确实让那种经历感觉有了价值。

sentences.en: And it doesn't make it less painful, but it does make that experience feel like it's worth something.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我有幸听到那些被我参与或贡献的工作所实质性改变和帮助过的人的声音。

sentences.en: And, you know, I get the absolute privilege of hearing from people who have been, you know,
sentences.zh: 我记得17岁的我坐在学校里，和朋友们试图找出我们能做些什么来改变世界。

sentences.en: materially changed and helped by, work that I've been involved in or contributed to.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，你意识到实际上改变世界并产生那么大的影响，是在与人们相处的安静时刻中发生的。

sentences.en: And I remember little 17 year old me sat at school with my friends trying to work out what we were going to do to change the world.
sentences.zh: 如果你能阻止一个人结束自己的生命，或者你能为一个人提供正确的支持，随着时间的推移，这种连锁反应是极其巨大的。

sentences.en: And over time, you realize that actually changing the world and creating that much impact in reality happens in really quiet moments with people.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，就像我，我现在回想起17岁的自己，

sentences.en: And if you can stop one person from taking their own life or you get the right support to one person, the ripple effect of that over time is absolutely enormous.
sentences.zh: 不知道自己该做什么，或者如何把这种可怕的经历变成一件好事。

sentences.en: And so, you know, like I, I remember just thinking back now to 17 year old me,
sentences.zh: 嗯，他绝对不会相信我们在过去八年里所做的一切。

sentences.en: not knowing what I was meant to do or how I was going to turn this awful experience into something that was good.
sentences.zh: 这是一段最非凡、最强大、最有意义的旅程。

sentences.en: Um, he would not believe what we've done over the last eight years.
sentences.zh: 我现在可以带着微笑说出这句话。

sentences.en: It's been the most extraordinary, powerful, meaningful journey.
sentences.zh: 就像它，我的故事非常悲伤，

sentences.en: And I can say that now with a smile on my face.
sentences.zh: 但它现在已经到了一个阶段，变成了一段非常快乐、积极的旅程。

sentences.en: Like it has, it, my story is so sad,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我曾经，我曾经不相信这是可能的。

sentences.en: but it's got to position now where it's a really happy, positive journey.
sentences.zh: 所以那是，哇，那太美好了。

sentences.en: Um, and that I didn't, I didn't believe that was ever possible.
sentences.zh: “美好”这个词用得不对。

sentences.en: So that's, wow, that's so pretty.
sentences.zh: 不，它是，是的，我知道。

sentences.en: That's pretty is the wrong word.
sentences.zh: 而且只有在某些时候，你才会真正反思并感叹，

sentences.en: No, it's, yeah, I know.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it's only sometimes that you actually reflect and go,
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: yeah,
sentences.zh: 是啊，

sentences.en: when Sam died, I honestly didn't think anything good would ever happen to me again.
sentences.zh: 当萨姆去世时，我真的以为自己再也不会遇到什么好事了。

sentences.en: I don't know how to describe it, except that I just thought my life was always going to be gray.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么形容，我当时只觉得我的人生将永远是一片灰暗。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Um, and I just didn't think anything would be fun or funny or positive.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我当时觉得什么都不会再有趣、好笑或积极了。

sentences.en: And so it's quite profound to be able to sit here now and say,
sentences.zh: 所以，现在能坐在这里说出这些话，意义非常深远，

sentences.en: this is great.
sentences.zh: 现在感觉很棒。

sentences.en: I love what I do.
sentences.zh: 我热爱我的工作。

sentences.en: I feel joy almost every day.
sentences.zh: 我几乎每天都能感受到快乐。

sentences.en: Um, and that, that's been quite, quite the journey to get there, but it's, it's very meaningful.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这一路走来确实非常、非常不容易，但这一切都非常有意义。

sentences.en: I've been approaching my health really differently this year.
sentences.zh: 今年我对待健康的方式有了很大的改变。

sentences.en: I used to be really focused on maximizing and doing more.
sentences.zh: 我过去总是专注于追求极致，做更多的事情。

sentences.en: And now I'm just realizing that if I listen to what my body needs, I perform way better.
sentences.zh: 但现在我意识到，如果我倾听身体的需求，我的表现会好得多。

sentences.en: And that's why I am obsessed with my whoop.
sentences.zh: 这就是我为什么对 Whoop 手环如此着迷的原因。

sentences.en: Truly, you guys, you know,
sentences.zh: 真的，伙计们，你们知道，

sentences.en: I'm such a data and information driven person.
sentences.zh: 我是一个非常依赖数据和信息的人。

sentences.en: And I love opening my whoop app and seeing how my sleep, my stress, my strain is correlating with my mood, with my running performance, with how I'm just feeling day to day.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢打开 Whoop 应用程序，看看我的睡眠、压力和劳损如何与我的情绪、跑步表现以及我每天的感受相关联。

sentences.en: I'm not an elite athlete by any means, but I do really benefit.
sentences.zh: 我绝不是什么精英运动员，但我确实从中受益匪浅。

sentences.en: And I also just really enjoy knowing more about my body.
sentences.zh: 而且我也真的很喜欢更多地了解自己的身体。

sentences.en: And whoop also gives me these actionable, personalized insights that have made me more intentional and meant that I make
sentences.zh: Whoop 还为我提供了可操作的个性化见解，让我变得更有目标感，也意味着我能
